name: POST /api/voice/webhooks/twilio/recording - Twilio recording-status callback
description: PUBLIC signed webhook: Twilio posts here once a call recording is ready, carrying RecordingSid, RecordingUrl and RecordingDuration. Authentication is by X-Twilio-Signature exactly as for the status callback (fail-closed once TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN is set, permissive when unconfigured so local/test runs work unsigned); the gateway allowlists the /api/voice/webhooks/ prefix past the default-deny authGate. The recording fields are merged onto the existing call row — COALESCE means a re-delivery of the same recording is idempotent and a callback missing a field never nulls a value already stored. Edge cases: an unrecognised or absent CallSid is acknowledged with 202 rather than 404 so Twilio stops retrying; recordings can arrive AFTER the call is already completed, which is normal and does not alter the call status; 401 InvalidSignature only when a token is configured and the signature does not verify.

testCases.name: Recording ready for the placed call

errorCases.when: the CallSid is not in the mirror, or the payload has no CallSid — acknowledged so Twilio stops retrying
TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN is configured and X-Twilio-Signature is missing, wrong, or computed over different params
